# MissingGlyphs

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

What happens to a character that no registered font can draw.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Drop`: Leave the character out and record a `font` warning (the default).
- `Throw`: Stop generation with a [`MissingGlyphException`](missing-glyph-exception.md).
